overall: Six talks, 18 questions, no ambiguity requiring a mustFix on content. Distractors are mostly legitimate: literal readings of quotes (06:1, 08:0, 09:2), wrong-column graphic traps (09:1, 10:1), same-word reversal (11:1), and opposite-group (08:1). The main gaps against TOEIC and the rules: (1) too many easy items, 7 of 18, with l-talk-07 having two easy in one set; (2) hard items 4 of 18, mainly graphic and a quote item, while most non-graphic questions are one-sentence retrieval with distance 1-2 paraphrase; (3) several keys carry talk words (visitor, rent/space/home) and several easy distractors are unrelated mentions rather than same-word or form-right traps; (4) 11:2 'next' has a legitimate-but-risky second step in its options. No arithmetic is required anywhere, and no key appears as another question's option within a set. Band count: easy 7, medium 7, hard 4.
